description: Codex permission prompt whose heredoc holds BOTH a numbered row ("1. payload") and a whole-row copy of the prompt below it. The real prompt is the one level with the real options (the last option-1 row); the command's rows, the quoted prompt among them, are indented deeper. Pairing the copy with the payload row as an earlier menu would cut the command to its tail, so commands differing in the prefix would share an identity. Synthetic.
